description: The plot illustrates the validation performance of two models—SMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, as measured by the metric BPC (Bits Per Character) on the y-axis, which decreases as model performance improves. The x-axis represents Training Steps, scaled in units of 10³ (thousands), ranging from 0 to 50,000 steps, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000 steps. The y-axis ranges from approximately 1.2 to 2.2 BPC, with gridlines at 0.2 intervals. The black line with triangle markers, labeled “SMoE Validating,” begins at approximately 2.15 BPC at 0 steps, drops sharply to around 1.3 BPC by 20,000 steps, and then stabilizes near 1.25 BPC through 50,000 steps. The magenta line with diamond markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” starts slightly higher at about 2.2 BPC, also declines steeply to roughly 1.3 BPC by 20,000 steps, and then fluctuates slightly around 1.25–1.27 BPC for the remainder of training. Both models converge to similar performance levels after 20,000 steps, though SimSMoE exhibits slightly more variability in the later stages.
